SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_NEOW.title: Neow's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_NEOW.description: At the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. [gold]Vow[/gold]: once per run, when you would die, stay at [blue]1[/blue] HP instead.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_OROBAS.title: Orobas' Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_OROBAS.description: After every combat, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold and have a [blue]{Chance}%[/blue] chance to find a potion. [gold]Vow[/gold]: [gold]Elites[/gold] drop an extra relic.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_NONUPEIPE.title: Nonupeipe's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_NONUPEIPE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Vow[/gold]: also gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_PAEL.title: Pael's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_PAEL.description: After every combat victory, gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP, up to [blue]{Cap}[/blue] per act.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_DARV.title: Darv's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_DARV.description: On the first turn of combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional card(s). [gold]From III[/gold]: also gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_DARV.flavor: "Found it in the pile! Have a gander!"
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_TANX.title: Tanx's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_TANX.description: Your first attack each combat deals [red]{Damage}[/red] additional damage. [gold]Vow[/gold]: against [gold]Elites[/gold] and [gold]Bosses[/gold], start with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_TEZCATARA.title: Tezcatara's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_TEZCATARA.description: When you [gold]Rest[/gold], heal an additional [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. [gold]Vow[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_VAKUU.title: Vakuu's Keepsake {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_VAKUU.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]{Blood}. [gold]Vow[/gold]: the blood price is waived.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_VAKUU.flavor: A contract, signed in a hand you recognise.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_MERCHANT.title: The Merchant's Ledger {Level}
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_MERCHANT.description: All shop items are [blue]{Discount}%[/blue] off. [gold]From III[/gold]: card removal is free.
SPIRETALK-KEEPSAKE_MERCHANT.flavor: "Heh heh. Regulars get the good page."

SPIRETALK-DEAL_OROBAS.title: {Npc}'s Deal
SPIRETALK-DEAL_NONUPEIPE.title: {Npc}'s Deal
SPIRETALK-DEAL_NONUPEIPE.flavor: A promise should look as good as it sounds.

SPIRETALK-DEAL_DARV.title: {Npc}'s Deal
SPIRETALK-DEAL_DARV.flavor: Filed under 'things you said'. Darv keeps everything.

SPIRETALK-DEAL_TEZCATARA.title: {Npc}'s Deal
SPIRETALK-DEAL_TEZCATARA.flavor: Keep it, dear, and come back for soup.

SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_FAVOR.title: The Merchant's Favour
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_FAVOR.description: Your next shop is [gold]{Discount}%[/gold] off, card removal included. Spent once you walk in.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_GRUDGE.title: The Merchant's Grudge
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_GRUDGE.description: Every shop costs [red]{Markup}%[/red] more for the rest of this run, card removal included.
